aggregated_trade_demonstration.quantity_unit: source quantity for symbol base asset; contract multiplier is unqualified
aggregated_trade_demonstration.quote_notional_unit: USDT from price x quantity; contract multiplier is unqualified
aggregated_trade_demonstration.side_convention: buyer_is_maker=true => seller taker/aggressive sell; false => buyer taker/aggressive buy

volume_profile.method: POC=max volume (ties lower price); expand adjacent observed price bins by larger next volume until target; ties lower price

data_license: Binance Vision Dataset Terms v1.0, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; non-commercial use only; attribution retained.
limitations: Archive path identifies USD-M futures data but does not independently establish perpetual classification or current TRADING status.
REST public market data and historical execution rules were restricted; spreads, fills, queue priority, fees and historical filters remain unqualified.
Aggregated trades are executed-price records, not full level-2 order-book history.
scope: Historical Binance Vision USD-M archive acceptance only; no strategy or profitability evaluation.

units.aggTrades_quantity: source quantity in symbol base units; contract multiplier not independently qualified
units.funding_rate: published dimensionless rate; calc_time is Unix milliseconds UTC
units.kline_volume: base-asset units as published for the USD-M symbol; contract multiplier not independently qualified
units.taker_buy_volume: aggressive buyer quantity in base-asset units as published by Binance kline
units.taker_sell_volume: source total minus taker-buy quantity; consistency checked before derivation
